about_the_game:
This DLC is only compatible with Windows.

This DLC unlocks the following in HoloParade:
- New outfit release: Shirakami Fubuki's swimsuit costume
- New talent BGM release:
KONKON Beats - Original ver(with Fubuki's vocal) and Brass Arrange ver.
- Acquisition of the talent "Shirakami Fubuki":
Enter the gift code "SIRAKAMI" in the game after purchasing the DLC
(if already acquired, add one star).

■About the Outfit
You can switch costumes in the formation screen and the talent list screen.
The appearance changes, and about twice as many voice patterns are added.
There is no difference in the performance of the talents.

■About the Talent BGM
You can set a BGM for the talent in the formation screen and talent list screen, and when that talent marches in the parade, the BGM will change accordingly. The BGM unlocked in this DLC can be set for any talent, as long as they have a rarity of UR, not just for Shirakami Fubuki.
